Alternative ISOFIX Tethers (e.g., EzyDog): If you prefer not to buy a full elevated pod or basket seat, dedicated ISOFIX tethers plug straight into your car's lower anchor bars or top tether points and clip into your dog's harness.
Stability: Prevents the seat or bed from sliding, tipping, or rotating during sharp turns or sudden stops.
No Seatbelt Wear-and-Tear: Unlike traditional dog seatbelt attachments that cross over or anchor into the main vehicle buckle, ISOFIX uses dedicated metal loops.
Quick Installation: Click-in design makes moving the bed between cars fast and straightforward.

references.title: Luther Bennett Travel Dog Pod 2.0 Dog Car Seat with ISOFIX
references.snippet: Hit the road in comfort and confidence with the Luther Bennett Isofix Travel Dog Pod. Designed for little adventurers who love to go with you, this clever dog car seat keeps your pup safe, snug and settled on every journey. Whether it’s a quick trip to the shops or a weekend adventure its cosy, enclosed design creates a calm little den for your dog to relax in. Thoughtfully made for both comfort and convenience, it’s the travel essential for pawrents looking for stress free trips with their four legged travel pal. It’s easy to install and remove for fuss free adventures, and it comes with everything you need to get on the road! This lightweight dog car seat is designed for small to medium breeds. Dual-purpose design works as both a car seat and a travel dog bed. Cosy, enclosed space helps dogs feel safe and settled on the move. Great for reducing travel anxiety and keeping your dog relaxed. Can be installed in the front or back seat to suit your dog. see instructions. Soft well padded interior for maximum comfort on every trip. Isofix hooks attach to the car’s anchor points for secure, simple installation. The safety straps loop over the headrest and/or around the seat for added stability. Safety lead attaches to the internal d-ring and your dog’s harness. 2 supplied It will take 2 small dogs. See size to check both dogs will comfortably fit in the pod. Unzip to use as a dog bed at your destination and during pit stops. Double stitched in high-stress areas for added strength and durability. Durable fabric is scratch, stain and water resistant for a practical solution. Sturdy handles make it easy to carry to and from your vehicle. Side pockets are handy for those travel essentials. TDP comes in cool colours and is machine washable to keep it looking fresh.

references.title: Tavo Dupree Small Dog Carrier & Car Seat with ISOFIX
references.snippet: Crash-tested car seat and airline-approved comfort for your pet The Tavo Dupree II is a carry-on pet transport carrier and also a certified car seat – specifically designed for small animals up to 9 kg. It is secured directly via ISOFIX in the vehicle, without the need for an additional base, and meets the UN-ECE R129 crash test standards. Perfect for safe travel by car and airplane. Product description Whether traveling, in the car, or at the airport – the Dupree II offers your pet protection, comfort, and functionality all in one. Large mesh inserts provide air circulation and a view, while magnetic roll-up doors and a zipper window on the roof make access easy. The interior is sturdily shaped to prevent sagging and can be stored under most airplane seats. Two washable mattresses, high-quality materials with UPF 50+, and practical extras such as a shoulder strap, trolley sleeve, and leash pocket complete the concept.
